basic_details.job_title: HLL Chief Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited, a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, has invited applications for 1 post of Chief Manager (Biomedical) in its HCD (Projects & Services – Division) on an Executive – Fixed Term Contract, with posting at Hyderabad. The basic pay range is Rs. 50,000 – 80,000 per month. The essential qualification is BE / B.Tech in a listed discipline or M.Sc (Biomedical Instrumentation), with a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience. Applications are taken through a Google Form from 03.11.2026 to 18.11.2026.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form through the application link given in the notice.
Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website.
Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted.
Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum upload size is 10 MB per file.
Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required (CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip), each file under 10 MB.
Select the correct post applied for in the form.
Submit the form on or before 18.11.2026. Late submissions will not be considered.

The job title and reference code (HLL/HR/103/2026) must be clearly mentioned in the application form. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be considered, and no separate communication will be sent.
Completed prescribed application form in PDF or Word.
CV, educational/experience certificates and latest salary slip, if required.
SC/ST candidates: SC/ST Caste Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India.
OBC candidates: Other Backward Class Certificate (Non-Creamy Layer) in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India.
NOC at the time of the interview, for candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies.

content_sections.heading: About HLL
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. According to the notice, it commenced operations on 5 April 1969 and now has a presence across healthcare manufacturing, retail pharmacy, diagnostics, imaging services, healthcare infrastructure development, procurement consultancy, hospital management and other allied services. The notice states an annual business turnover of approximately ₹6,500 crore for the HLL Group.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience (essential): minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in strategic and regional leadership for biomedical projects and service operations, ensuring business growth, timely delivery, compliance, quality and strong client relationships. Age: maximum 47 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice says the date for determining the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. Nationality: only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives; the notice does not list the relaxation. Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_qualification: BE / B.Tech (Biomedical / Electronics & Instrumentation / Electronics & Communication / Medical Electronics) or M.Sc (Biomedical Instrumentation).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The basic pay range is Rs. 50,000 – 80,000 per month. At the minimum of the scale, the notice gives a gross salary of Rs. 1,08,050 (Metro) (approx.) and an annual CTC of 15.11 Lakhs (Metro) (approx.). The contract type is Executive – Fixed Term Contract; the length of the term is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: HLL Chief Manager (Biomedical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead planning and delivery of projects across the assigned region for central/state departments, medical colleges, AIIMS-type institutes and government hospitals. Set and approve technical and commercial strategies for proposals, tenders, specifications and BOQs. Ensure compliance with GFR, Department of Expenditure procurement manuals, CVC guidelines, GeM, Make in India and MSE procurement policy. Oversee vendor empanelment, negotiations and contract approvals, including extensions and variations within delegated financial powers. Engage with institute leadership and central/state departments for projects under schemes. Oversee audit, RTI, grievance and dispute matters, including responses to CAG, CVC and statutory audits. Review project and service performance against timelines, cost, quality, safety, uptime and SLAs; oversee billing and payment controls. Ensure smooth transition to warranty and CAMC and monitor service revenue, margins and recoveries. Provide overall supervision, leadership and performance monitoring of Biomedical Managers and Biomedical Engineers, ensuring effective project execution, coordination and timely delivery. Build and maintain senior relationships with institute directors, medical superintendents, government departments and consultants. Drive business development, new project opportunities and process improvements; report performance and key risks to top management. Perform any other duties assigned by management.

NOC at the time of the interview, for candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that all information submitted in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of the interview. If any information is found to be false, incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected or cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process. HLL reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the selection process, or not to fill any or all of the posts notified. The decision of Management regarding selection will be final. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.
